svg.aria-label: P2-w: irq_unlock() after a wake under irq_lock() does not preempt (CONFIG_USE_SWITCH=y)

g.data-tip: t3 (preemptible): thread priority 0.

g.data-tip: Same thread priority (1): t1 (preemptible), t2 (preemptible). These contexts cannot preempt each other. A pending one waits until the running one ends or blocks.

g.data-tip: t3 (preemptible): k_sem_take(o1). Step 1 of the TLC trace (state 1 -> 2). k_sem_take(o1, K_FOREVER) (sem.c:127): k_spin_lock(&sem_lock) (sem.c:134). k_spin_lock() raises BASEPRI (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57). The count is 0: z_pend_curr() (sem.c:153). The model object o1 stands for each object: each wait of an object calls z_pend_curr().
g.title: t3 (preemptible): k_sem_take(o1). Step 1 of the TLC trace (state 1 -> 2). k_sem_take(o1, K_FOREVER) (sem.c:127): k_spin_lock(&sem_lock) (sem.c:134). k_spin_lock() raises BASEPRI (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57). The count is 0: z_pend_curr() (sem.c:153). The model object o1 stands for each object: each wait of an object calls z_pend_curr().

g.data-tip: t3 (preemptible): z_pend_curr(). z_pend_curr() (sched.c:531) -> pend_locked() (sched.c:559) -> add_to_waitq_locked() (sched.c:429) -> unready_thread() (sched.c:434): t3 leaves the run queue and waits on o1. unready_thread() calls update_cache(thread == _current) = update_cache(1) (sched.c:247). update_cache(1) (sched.c:161): preempt_ok = 1, so should_preempt() returns true at once (kthread.h:248-249). cache = next_up() = head of the run queue = t1 (sched.c:173).
g.title: t3 (preemptible): z_pend_curr(). z_pend_curr() (sched.c:531) -> pend_locked() (sched.c:559) -> add_to_waitq_locked() (sched.c:429) -> unready_thread() (sched.c:434): t3 leaves the run queue and waits on o1. unready_thread() calls update_cache(thread == _current) = update_cache(1) (sched.c:247). update_cache(1) (sched.c:161): preempt_ok = 1, so should_preempt() returns true at once (kthread.h:248-249). cache = next_up() = head of the run queue = t1 (sched.c:173).

g.data-tip: t3 (preemptible): z_swap(): switch. z_swap_locked() (sched.c:561, kswap.h:234) -> do_swap() (kswap.h:183, kswap.h:79): new thread = _kernel.ready_q.cache = t1 (kswap.h:112), arch_switch() (kswap.h:162) = arm_m_switch() (arm-m-switch.h:220). The new thread sets BASEPRI 0 after the stack switch (arm-m-switch.h:307).
g.title: t3 (preemptible): z_swap(): switch. z_swap_locked() (sched.c:561, kswap.h:234) -> do_swap() (kswap.h:183, kswap.h:79): new thread = _kernel.ready_q.cache = t1 (kswap.h:112), arch_switch() (kswap.h:162) = arm_m_switch() (arm-m-switch.h:220). The new thread sets BASEPRI 0 after the stack switch (arm-m-switch.h:307).

g.data-tip: t1 (preemptible): irq_lock(). Step 2 of the TLC trace (state 2 -> 3). irq_lock() = arch_irq_lock(): key = BASEPRI = 0 (asm_inline_gcc.h:56), BASEPRI = _EXC_IRQ_DEFAULT_PRIO (asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57). No interrupt that calls the kernel runs until the unlock.
g.title: t1 (preemptible): irq_lock(). Step 2 of the TLC trace (state 2 -> 3). irq_lock() = arch_irq_lock(): key = BASEPRI = 0 (asm_inline_gcc.h:56), BASEPRI = _EXC_IRQ_DEFAULT_PRIO (asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57). No interrupt that calls the kernel runs until the unlock.

g.data-tip: t1 (preemptible): t1 runs. t1 runs its own code in thread mode. BASEPRI stays raised by the outer irq_lock() (asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57).
g.title: t1 (preemptible): t1 runs. t1 runs its own code in thread mode. BASEPRI stays raised by the outer irq_lock() (asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57).

g.data-tip: t1 (preemptible): k_sem_give(o1). Step 3 of the TLC trace (state 3 -> 4). k_sem_give(o1) (sem.c:95): k_spin_lock(&sem_lock) (sem.c:97). k_spin_lock() raises BASEPRI (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57). z_sched_wake(0) (sem.c:102, ksched.h:295): the best waiter leaves the wait queue (ksched.h:301), its timeout is cancelled (ksched.h:262), it gets the return value 0 and is made ready (ksched.h:306). Woken: t3. Each woken thread: ready_thread() (sched.c:212): queue_thread() (sched.c:224), update_cache(0) (sched.c:225). On one CPU z_sched_wake() takes no second lock (kspinlock.h:23-25). update_cache(0) (sched.c:161): _current t1 is preemptible, so should_preempt() is true (kthread.h:262-263). cache = next_up() = head of the run queue = t3 (sched.c:173). The trace does not name one action: the same states also come from t1: k_event_post(o1) or t1: wake with object code(o1).
g.title: t1 (preemptible): k_sem_give(o1). Step 3 of the TLC trace (state 3 -> 4). k_sem_give(o1) (sem.c:95): k_spin_lock(&sem_lock) (sem.c:97). k_spin_lock() raises BASEPRI (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57). z_sched_wake(0) (sem.c:102, ksched.h:295): the best waiter leaves the wait queue (ksched.h:301), its timeout is cancelled (ksched.h:262), it gets the return value 0 and is made ready (ksched.h:306). Woken: t3. Each woken thread: ready_thread() (sched.c:212): queue_thread() (sched.c:224), update_cache(0) (sched.c:225). On one CPU z_sched_wake() takes no second lock (kspinlock.h:23-25). update_cache(0) (sched.c:161): _current t1 is preemptible, so should_preempt() is true (kthread.h:262-263). cache = next_up() = head of the run queue = t3 (sched.c:173). The trace does not name one action: the same states also come from t1: k_event_post(o1) or t1: wake with object code(o1).

g.data-tip: t1 (preemptible): z_reschedule(): no switch. z_reschedule() (sem.c:110, sched.c:652): resched() is false: the key of k_spin_lock() is the BASEPRI of the outer irq_lock(), not 0 (asm_inline_gcc.h:56, asm_inline_gcc.h:104-105, sched.c:374). k_spin_unlock() (sched.c:401) writes this key back: BASEPRI stays raised. No switch, although the cache is t3 and _current is t1.

No switch, although the cache is t3 and _current is t1.

g.data-tip: t1 (preemptible): irq_unlock(key). Step 4 of the TLC trace (state 4 -> 5). irq_unlock(key) = arch_irq_unlock(key) (asm_inline_gcc.h:89): BASEPRI = key = 0. No kernel code: irq_unlock() is not a reschedule point. The cache t3 != _current t1 stays: no switch.
g.title: t1 (preemptible): irq_unlock(key). Step 4 of the TLC trace (state 4 -> 5). irq_unlock(key) = arch_irq_unlock(key) (asm_inline_gcc.h:89): BASEPRI = key = 0. No kernel code: irq_unlock() is not a reschedule point. The cache t3 != _current t1 stays: no switch.
